readings: For each media type ID, show its average track unit price and how that compares to the overall average track price, as a ratio (its average divided by the overall average). Leave the numbers unrounded. List the top 10 by that ratio, highest first, with any missing ratios last.
queries:
SELECT
    m.MediaTypeId,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageTrackUnitPrice,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS PriceRatio
FROM MediaType AS m
LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
ORDER BY PriceRatio IS NULL, PriceRatio DESC
LIMIT 10;
